business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 Business description and 10-K MD&A overview.
business_model.claim: Accelerant operates a data-driven Risk Exchange that connects specialty insurance underwriters (MGAs, the 'Sellers') with Risk Capital Partners (insurers, reinsurers, institutional investors, the 'Buyers'), reducing information asymmetries in the traditional insurance value chain.
quotes: We operate a data-driven risk exchange that connects selected specialty insurance underwriters (the "Sellers" on our platform) with Risk Capital Partners (the "Buyers" on our platform).

Our Risk Exchange reduces information asymmetries and operational barriers present in the traditional insurance value chain by leveraging proprietary technology to share actionable high-fidelity data and insights with platform participants.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 1 Business and 10-K MD&A.
business_model.claim: Accelerant reports three operating segments: Exchange Services (core fee-based platform), MGA Operations (Mission Underwriters incubator and Owned Members), and Underwriting (retained underwriting profit).
quotes: We generate revenue through three separate operating segments: Exchange Services, MGA Operations, and Underwriting.
We operate our business across three reportable segments – Exchange Services, which is the core of Accelerant, as well as MGA Operations and Underwriting.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K MD&A business model section and 10-K Item 1.
business_model.claim: Exchange Services revenue is a fixed-percentage, volume-based fee paid by Risk Capital Partners for sourcing, managing, and monitoring the portfolio of business written by Members, netted by performance-based commissions paid to Members.
quotes: Risk Capital Partners writing premiums directly through the Risk Exchange pay us a fixed-percentage, volume-based fee for sourcing, managing and monitoring the business they write, which is netted by the amount the Risk Exchange pays in performance-based commissions to Members.
Risk Capital Partners who provide capacity through our Risk Exchange pay us recurring fees to source, manage, and monitor risks on their behalf.

business_model.claim: MGA Operations generates commission revenue from consolidated Mission Members (31 as of Dec 2025) and Owned Members (15 as of Dec 2025), plus equity income from minority-owned Members; these Members contributed $1.21 billion in Exchange Written Premium, or 29% of total, in 2025.
quotes: Our MGA Operations segment includes both Mission Underwriters' consolidated results and those of Owned Members in which we have a majority ownership positions.
For the year ended December 31, 2025, these Members contributed $1.21 billion, in Exchange Written Premium, or 29% of our total Exchange Written Premium for that period.

business_model.claim: The Underwriting segment captures net underwriting profit from the approximately 10% of Risk Exchange premium retained by Accelerant Underwriting, after ceding roughly 90% to Risk Capital Partners via reinsurance.
quotes: Our Underwriting segment captures the portion of the Risk Exchange portfolio written by Accelerant Underwriting and the corresponding underwriting profit realized on retained business.

We have historically targeted to reinsure 90% of premiums written and reinsured by Accelerant Underwriting through the Risk Exchange to Risk Capital Partners, with Accelerant retaining approximately 10%.
